decisions.reason: After several years on the market, this supplement line appears well aligned with the firm's existing consumer-health knowledge base, so the firm can keep refining and supporting it through established development, quality, and pharmacy-channel capabilities.

The skin and hair supplement remains close to the firm's OTC and pharmacy-oriented business, and continued survival suggests the firm has been able to absorb market feedback and improve or position it without major strain.

Although this mushroom-based immune supplement is more niche and commercially uncertain, it still builds on related supplement capabilities and can be sustained while the firm uses its formulation, quality, and branding knowledge to test and adjust it.

The OTC migraine triptan is less closely related than the supplement products, but as a large pharmaceutical firm with in-house R&D, regulatory know-how, and manufacturing depth, the company has sufficient absorptive capacity to continue learning from and supporting it rather than exiting now.
